programme.title: Mad Max - As Motos Da Morte
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo e apocalíptico, Mad Max Rockatansky, um destemido polícia vestido de cabedal, declara guerra aos assassinos motorizados que apontaram armas à sua família.

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: Atena
programme.desc: Atena foi abusada pelo pai durante a infância. Como ele desapareceu, ela faz hoje justiça pelas próprias mãos em casos semelhantes que ocorrem na sua cidade brasileira. Com a ajuda do jornalista Carlos, Atena encontra o pai em Montevideu e não vai descansar enquanto não se vingar.

programme.title: O Espectro De Sharon Tate
programme.desc: Aos 26 anos, Sharon Tate é uma estrela em ascensão em Hollywood, que está prestes a dar à luz o seu primeiro filho, do realizador Roman Polanski. Atormentada por terríveis visões, os seus piores pesadelos tornar-se-ão realidade com a entrada em cena de Charles Manson e do seu culto mortal.

programme.title: A Partida
programme.desc: Ben e a sua melhor amiga Tanner resolvem pregar uma partida à professora de Física que ameaça reprová-los, acusando-a falsamente nas redes sociais do homicídio de um estudante.

programme.title: O Doutrinador
programme.desc: Às vésperas das eleições presidenciais no Brasil, uma tragédia pessoal leva um agente treinado a lançar-se numa cruzada contra a corrupção endémica do país e os políticos e empresários que enriquecem às custas da miséria e do trabalho da população.

programme.title: O Mauritano
programme.desc: Mohamedou Ould Slahi é detido pelo governo dos EUA logo a seguir ao 11 de Setembro, e é encarcerado em Guantánamo sem julgamento durante anos. Os seus únicos aliados são a advogada de defesa Nancy Hollander e a sua associada Teri Duncan que tentam lutar por justiça e descobrir toda a verdade.

programme.title: As Coisas Que Dizemos, As Coisas Que Fazemos
programme.desc: Daphne, grávida de três meses, está de férias no campo e enquanto espera que o seu companheiro François, ausente em trabalho, vá ter com ela, vai-se aproximando de Maxime, um primo que nunca conhecera e de quem vai ficando cada vez mais íntima.

programme.title: Rumo À Liberdade
programme.desc: Um pequeno grupo de prisioneiros de várias nacionalidades foge de um gulag na Sibéria em 1940, e atravessa mais de seis mil quilómetros por cinco países hostis para chegar à liberdade na Índia.

programme.title: As Aventuras Do Dr. Dolittle
programme.desc: John Dolittle é um médico que consegue falar com animais e se lança numa aventura para encontrar uma ilha lendária com um jovem aprendiz e uma tripulações de estranha bicharada.

programme.title: Academia De Polícia 4 A Patrulha Do Cidadão
programme.desc: O pelotão de desastrados da Academia de Polícia tem por missão treinar no combate ao crime um novo grupo de voluntários civis, só que o Capitão Harris vai faze de tudo para sabotar o novo programa.

programme.title: Moonfall Rota De Colisão
programme.desc: Uma força misteriosa tira a Lua da sua órbita em torno da Terra e envia-a numa rota de colisão capaz de aniquilar a vida como a conhecemos. Semanas antes do impacto, três heróis improváveis vão lançar-se numa última missão no espaço, e descobrem que a nossa Lua não é o que pensávamos que era.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Num futuro não muito distante, em que as calotas polares derreteram e a maioria do planeta está debaixo de água, um marinheiro mutante luta contra a fome e os fora-da-lei, e acaba a contragosto por aceitar ajudar uma mulher e uma menina a encontrarem terra firme.

programme.title: Mad Max 2 - O Guerreiro Da Estrada
programme.desc: Num futuro devastado, o cada vez mais cínico e descrente Max aceita ajudar uma pequena comunidade com acesso a gasolina a livrar-se do grupo de guerreiros sanguinários que a quer eliminar.

programme.title: Fim De Turno
programme.desc: Na zona de South Central em Los Angeles, os polícias Brian Taylor e Mike Zavala estabelecem uma poderosa amizade para garantir que regressam sempre ambos a casa no Fim do Turno. Mas quando uma operação dá para o torto, tornam-se alvos a abater por um dos mais violentos carteis da região.

programme.title: É Só Querer
programme.desc: Após uma vida de estudo, um professor universitário, um explicador e um desempregado continuam sem dinheiro. A solução para os seus problemas pode estar num comprimido, que um deles criou, e que é uma droga que dá uma grande energia mas sem ressaca

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros

programme.title: Os Pobres Anos Dourados
programme.desc: Um casal reformado recusa-se a aceitar o corte das suas reformas e reúne um grupo de amigos para lutar pelos direitos de todos. A estratégia é simples assaltar bancos.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 119
programme.desc: Uma visão cómica e provocadora dos tempos que vivemos, com o realizador Michael Moore a explorar as duas questões cruciais da Era Trump como diabo chegámos aqui e como diabo conseguiremos nós escapar.

programme.title: Interrogation - Explosões Em Cadeia
programme.desc: Quando o FBI recebe a ameaça de que uma bomba vai explodir na cidade, um interrogador e uma informática envolvem-se numa série de jogos mentais com um criminoso, lutando contra o tempo para desvendar os seus verdadeiros motivos e impedir o desastre.

programme.title: Robinson Crusoé
programme.desc: Numa pequena ilha paradisíaca, o papagaio Terça-feira e o seu grupo de animais amigos encontram o náufrago Robinson Crusoé. No início, o convívio não é fácil mas lentamente, todos começam a viver juntos em harmonia, pelo menos até dois gatos virem colocar tudo em risco.

programme.title: Dartagnan, O 4 Mosqueteiro
programme.desc: A pedido do seu pai, o jovem DArtagnan viaja da Gasconha rural para Paris para se tornar mosqueteiro e acaba envolvido numa conspiração do traidor Conde Rochefort contra o Rei Luís XIV, juntando-se aos três célebres mosqueteiros para deter os inimigos da coroa.

programme.title: Bowfinger - O Sem Vergonha
programme.desc: Bobby Bowfinger, produtor de filmes, há anos que tenta conseguir um êxito de bilheteira. O seu próximo filme terá tudo o que um grande sucesso precisa ação, alienígenas, uma bela jovem e Kit Ramsey, a maior estrela de Hollywood. Só há um senão o próprio Kit não sabe que foi escolhido para o papel.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Num futuro não muito distante, em que as calotas polares derreteram e a maioria do planeta está debaixo de água, um marinheiro mutante luta contra a fome e os fora-da-lei, e acaba a contragosto por aceitar ajudar uma mulher e uma menina a encontrarem terra firme.

programme.title: O Coletivo
programme.desc: Um jovem recruta para uma misteriosa agência de assassinos torna-se um pária na sua primeira missão, rastreando um perigoso grupo de traficantes de pessoas.

programme.title: Golpe Final
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de terroristas lhe raptam a sobrinha no estádio do West Ham durante um jogo de futebol, Michael Knox, um ex-soldado, trava uma guerra sem quartel para a salvar e prevenir uma bomba de explodir no recinto, que tem 35 mil pessoas lá dentro impedidas de sair.

programme.title: Greenland O Último Refúgio
programme.desc: Uma família luta pela sobrevivência quando um cometa destruidor de planetas chega à Terra. John Garrity, a sua ex-mulher e o seu filho fazem uma perigosa viagem até à sua derradeira esperança de salvação, à medida que a contagem decrescente para o apocalipse global se aproxima do zero.

programme.title: Mad Max Além Da Cúpula Do Trovão
programme.desc: Dois homens entram e só um sai é essa a lei da arena Thunderdome em Bartertown, a cidade perdida governada pela poderosa Aunty Entity. Quando Max é exilado de lá, encontra em pleno deserto uma comunidade isolada de crianças. Mas sobreviver continua a não ser mesmo nada fácil

programme.title: Emboscada
programme.desc: Durante a guerra do Vietname, um grupo de comandos de elite americanos, liderados pelo Capitão Drummond, são encarregues de recolher informação altamente confidencial numa missão arriscada que poderá mudar por completo o rumo do conflito.

programme.title: O Diário De Uma Rapariga Adolescente
programme.desc: Minnie Goetze tem 15 anos, quer ser desenhadora de BD e está a crescer no ambiente frenético da São Francisco dos anos 70. É uma típica adolescente em quase tudo, exceto no facto de descobrir o sexo com o namorado da mãe, com quem acaba por manter uma relação, mesmo depois desta descobrir...

programme.title: Live in Aix-en-Provence
programme.desc: The shy and elusive Grigroy Sokolov is one of the greatest pianists of our time. His performances leave critics and audiences alike speechless, like they don't quite believe what they have just experienced. In 2015, he played a beautiful recital with works by Johann Sebastian Bach, Ludwig van Beethoven, Franz Schubert, Frédéric Chopin, and Claude Debussy that took place at the Festival La Roque D'Anthéron in Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Mahler - The Song of Lamentation
programme.desc: Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería and four vocal soloists in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s cantata ‘The Song of Lamentation’ (Das klagende Lied). Among the soloists are soprano Sally Dibblee, mezzo-soprano Marjorie Elinor Dix, tenor Arturo Chacón, and bass Stephen West.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Mahler - Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children. The work's emotional depth comes from its unflinching portrayal of grief through a powerful juxtaposition of natural imagery and intimate parental pain.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 21 - III
programme.desc: Julijana Sarac performs the first/third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 21 (“Waldstein”). The work was completed in 1804 and is considered one of Beethoven's greatest and most technically challenging piano sonatas.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Duparc, Borodin et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Esther Valentin (Germany, 1993) and pianist Anastasia Grishutina (Russia, 1988) perform Henri Duparc’s L’invitation au voyage; Aleksandr Borodin’s ‘Dlya beregov otchizni dal’noy’ (For the shores of thy far native land); ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op. 39; Franz Schubert’s Die Liebe hat gelogen, Op. 23 No. 1 (D.

programme.title: Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of 'Overture Rosamunde' (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828). Recorded in Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, the Netherlands in 2015. Schubert initially composed the Overture for Georg Ernst von hofmann's play 'Die Zauberharfe' ('The Magic Harp'), which premiered on August 19, 1820.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 7 And 13, and Op. 133
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Mozart - Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622
programme.desc: Conductor Marien van Staalen leads Amadeus Ensemble Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Clarinet Concerto in A major, K. 622. Henk de Graaf is the featured soloist. This performance was recorded at St. Nicholas Church in Vollenhove, the Netherlands.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Solos for Clarinet, Part I
programme.desc: The great clarinettist Paolo Beltramini plays a program of solo pieces for clarinet on Stingray Brava. In this broadcast, Beltramini performs C.P.E. Bach’s Solfeggietto, Béla Kovàc’s Hommage à Paganini, and Igor Stravinsky’s Three Pieces for Clarinet Solo. Paolo Beltramini is the only Italian clarinettist to have won first prize at the prestigious Prague Spring International Clarinet Competition (1996).

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Chausson And Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Discover the next generation of chamber music talent from the Reina Sofía School of Music. In the first half of this program, Trio Michelangeli presents two masterpieces: Joseph Haydn’s Piano Trio No. 39 in G major, nicknamed ‘Gypsy’, followed by the romanticism of Ernest Chausson’s Piano Trio in G minor. The concert concludes with a performance by the Erinys Quartet of Felix Mendelssohn’s inventive String Quartet No. 2 in A minor.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations, BWV 988
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In the current recital, Bacchetti performs J. S.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 9, a profoundly emotional and technically complex work from 1909-1910, is characterized by its sprawling, late-Romantic style, exploring themes of human experience, love, and existential questions against the backdrop of Mahler's own impending death.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 6 BWV 1019
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No.6 BWV 1019 is the last of the set of sonatas that Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably while working as chapel master in Köthen. He presumably wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Echoes of San Marco And Fellini
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the Giuseppe Nicolini Conservatory of Piacenza and the Giuseppe Verdi of Milan as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme.” On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. “Echoes of San Marco” is a tribute to the Venetian Renaissance composer Giovanni Gabrieli (1555-1612).

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Bach - Partita for Violin No. 2 (BWV 1004)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Partita No. 2 is made up of four dance movements, concluded by its famous Chaconne, a monumental piece within the violin repertoire.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 8 in G major, Op. 88
programme.desc: Colombian principal conductor Andrés Orozco-Estrada took the Spanish Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet on the road to perform at some of Europe’s greatest music centers in celebration of Madrid’s Reina Sofía School of Music’s 30th anniversary. This concert features a wonderful performance of Antonín Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8 in G major, Op. 88. It was recorded at the Liszt Ferenc Academy of Music in Budapest, Hungary on October 20, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, “Titan”. Composed between 1887 and 1888, the symphony blends traditional form with innovative ideas like folk melodies, march rhythms, and fanfare motifs.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Haydn, Schubert et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Ema Nikolovska (Canada, 1993) and pianist Michael Sikich (United States, 1993) perform ‘The sailor’s song’ from Joseph Haydn’s Six original canzonettas, Book 2 – Hob. XXVIa; Franz Schubert’s Auf dem See, Op. 92 No. 2 (D. 543); ‘Botschaft’ from Johannes Brahms’s Fünf Lieder, Op. 47; ‘Röselein, Röselein!’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Sonata for Cello, Op. 19
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Anthony Ratinov
programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 And 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw (2020)
programme.desc: Misha Fomin performed romantic piano works at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in November 2020. His recital opened with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 10, Op. 14/2 and Sonata No. 15, Op. 28 'Pastoral'. He continued the program with a performance of Frédéric Chopin's Nocturne Op. 9/1, Etude Op. 25/7, and Johannes Brahms's technically demanding 'Variations on a Theme by Paganini', Op. 35 (Book II).

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw
programme.desc: Since his spectacular debut recital at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in 2002, pianist Misha Fomin has become an indispensable part of Dutch musical life. National and international press praise his playing for its fluently natural virtuosity, rich color palette, and great musical intelligence.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris.

programme.title: Giselle
programme.desc: Choreographed by Charles Jude, the ballet Giselle by Jean Coralli and Jules Perrot, with music by Adolphe Adam, tells the story of a lovely peasant girl by the same name. Giselle was first presented at Théâtre de l'Académie Royale de Musique in Salle Le Peletier in Paris on June 28, 1841. The story is set in the Rhineland of the Middle Ages during the grape harvest. Giselle falls in love with Albrecht, the Duke of Silesia.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano: Mozart, Beethoven a.o.
programme.desc: On the occasion of International Women’s Day, Italian violinist Laura Marzadori and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti performed a wonderful concert at Teatro Sociale di Camogli, Italy. On the program are Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Sonata No. 18 in G major, K. 301; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Mozart, Mendelssohn And Gershwin for 2 Pianos
programme.desc: Italian pianists Roberto Prosseda and Alessandra Ammara perform W. A. Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 488, Felix Mendelssohn's Sonata for two pianos in D major, MWV S 1, and George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue, during an off-season concert recorded at Fazioli Concert Hall in Sacile, Italy in June 26, 2020.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 12
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Fantasiestücke, Op. 12. Written in 1837, the work is a set of eight piano pieces with contrasting moods.

programme.title: Rota - The Godfather Suite
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone’s iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono and Bernard Herrmann.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies — to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune, and many more. Join the orchestra on the third and final symphonic journey through musical universes and cinematic galaxies — all the way to the outermost asteroids and back to Earth again.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world.

programme.title: Verdi - La forza del destino
programme.desc: Renato Palumbo conducts the Orchestra and Choirs of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s La forza del destino (The Force of Destiny). Verdi and his librettist Francesco Maria Piave based the work on a Spanish musical drama by Angel de Saavedra, ‘Don Álvaro o la fuerza del sino’. Composed for the imperial Russian opera in St. Petersburg, La forza premiered there in 1862.

programme.title: Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Italian cellist and conductor Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in this intimate concert at the magnificent Basilica di San Pietro in the Italian city of Perugia, recorded on September 27, 2021. Opening the program is a cello performance by Bronzi with the Orchestra da Camera di Peruglia: the Andante cantabile from Joseph Haydn’s Symphony No. 13 in D major, Hob. I:13.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.desc: Repórter CNN é um programa de reportagem transmitido pela CNN Portugal, focado em temas de grande relevância social, política, cultural e desportiva. programme.title: Salvar O Planeta
programme.desc: Os ambientalistas da Geração Z estão a impulsionar um movimento global para proteger e preservar o nosso planeta com ideias inovadoras, aproveitando o poder coletivo da sua geração. Sinopse ep 2: Cinco jovens activistas do clima partilham as suas soluções sobre tudo, desde a captura de emissões de carbono até à salvação das abelhas, num esforço coletivo para preservar o nosso planeta.

Em direto e a partir dos estúdios de Lisboa e do Porto, vamos estar de olhos postos em tudo o que acontece no continente, nas ilhas, em todas as geografias.

programme.title: Rui Maria Pêgo, Conversa Com… Anabela Becho
programme.desc: Conversas simples em que cada host convida o seu mundo de pessoas. Cada dia da semana um apresentador diferente e cada um define o seu conceito e escolhe os protagonistas em função do mesmo. De 2ª a 6ª Feira às 23h, uma conversa sempre diferente. Esta semana, Rui Maria Pêgo, CONVERSA COM... ANABELA BECHO. Com um simples vestido preto nunca me comprometo?

programme.title: A Letra: Edmundo Inácio - 'Terra'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas nas canções.Edmundo Inácio abraçou as mudanças todas que a vida lhe deu, espantando tudo e todos com a sua identidade inovadora. Mas sente a distância, e sabe que voltar a casa é cada vez mais dificil. Em 'Terra' escolhe contar a verdade sobre partir e deixar as origens.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Chick Corea Elektric Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Thalma de Freitas
programme.desc: Thalma de Freitas is a Brazilian singer, songwriter, and actress from Rio de Janeiro. Daughter of the renowned pianist Laércio de Freitas, her work is a masterful fusion of MPB (Brazilian Popular Music), jazz, and Afro-Brazilian influences. In 2019, her album ‘Sorte!’ was nominated for a Grammy Award. For this intimate performance, she is joined by guitarist Helô Ferreira.

programme.title: B.B. King: The King of the Blues in Stuttgart
programme.desc: This uptempo, funky performance proves that B.B. King, one of the Masters of the Blues Guitar has still got it. The band features some of today's best blues musicians playing all of B.B. King's classic songs.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Os Capoeira - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Os Capoeira.

programme.title: The Three Marias
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 And 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: What Is This Thing Called Love
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Natalia M. King
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: Mi Pañuelo
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Joel Hierrezuelo - Asi de Simple
programme.desc: Cuban singer, guitarist and percussionist Joel Hierrezuelo is known as the vocalist of the band Ricoson. He played percussion in the band Temperamento with Roberto Fonseca, Javier Zalba, and Ruy Lopez Nousa, and has worked with artists such as Alfredo Rodriguez and Los Acerekó, Omara Portuondo, Fatoumata Diawara, and Mayra Andrade.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Dee Dee Bridgewater
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: Liran Donin - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, Tel Aviv-born bass player, producer and composer Liran Donin appeared here.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis Quintet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American trumpeter and composer Wynton Marsalis and his quintet performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: Christian McBride - Brother Malcolm
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Ricardo Herz Trio - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. - Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr.

programme.title: Weather Update - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here.

programme.title: Marius Neset - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. In 2019, one of them is Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset, who is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.title: Guitarlegend Wes Montgomery in The Netherlands
programme.desc: Wes Montgomery: Live in '65 shines a light on one of the most unique and influential guitarists in music history. These beautifully filmed programs from the spring of 1965 feature Wes, in intimate studio settings, leading three different lineups through some of his best-known tunes, including “Four On Six”, “Jingles”, and “West Coast Blues”.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Keb' Mo
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: NSJ Vocal Selection: Carter, O'Day and Benjamin
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson with NHØP - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson gave a stunning performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Ladama - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Christian Scott - The Centennial Trilogy
programme.desc: In just a few years, young trumpet player Christian Scott has become synonymous with a new jazz generation. He shakes up the conventions of jazz by taking the genre to new horizons and reaching a wider audience. No doubt, at 33 years old, Christian Scott is already forging his own path. After each record release, he seems even more determined to challenge the rules of jazz with his own avant-garde style.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of 'neo-boppers' that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot.

programme.title: Fannie Mae
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: Love Ballad
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: I Want Your Love
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Badbadnotgood
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1978, the famed Chicago Blues All Star Band put on an electrifying performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins live in Belgium, 1962
programme.desc: A jazz festival named after the inventor of the instrument most associated with the genre, Adolphe Sax, would be incomplete without the man who laid the groundwork for how the instrument is played today. This must have been the reasoning of the organizers of the Festival International de Jazz Adolphe Sax in Dinant, Belgium, when they invited tenor saxophone giant Coleman Hawkins to perform there in June 1962.

programme.title: Misc: Jérôme Beaulieu live in Montreal
programme.desc: Modern jazz with a twist, based on a group effort rather than on personal virtuosity: meet Misc! Composer and pianist Jérôme Beaulieu, double bassist Philippe Leduc and drummer William Côté met during their college years at the Université de Montréal. Their Trio Jérôme Beaulieu quickly made a name for itself, winning the Montreal contest Jazz en Rafale and the Grand Prix du Festi-Jazz in Rimouski within the same year.

programme.title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: Moondog And The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Adjustment
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet And Rozaa Wortham 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: Mahavishnu Orchestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide.

programme.title: The Blue Note Masters
programme.desc: Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson and Joe Chambers are legends of Blue Note Records. They have established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Respect to Aretha
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx And Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Bill Laurance Project
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: Soul Makossa: Manu Dibango in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Manu Dibango, one of Africa’s biggest musical stars and top saxophonists, is an indispensable artist. He was one of the first African musicians to score a worldwide hit with his 1972 release “Soul Makossa”, paving the way for many other artists. The very concept of world music owes much to him.

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980.

programme.title: Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The concert features the full song performances from Tony and today's greatest artists as they were recorded live in the studio. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Mont Saint-Michel: Steve Grossman And Peter King
programme.desc: Every year, the Jazz en Baie festival takes place in the beautiful bay of Mont Saint-Michel. Today’s broadcast shows a special gathering between saxophone heavyweights Peter King and Steve Grossman. These experienced musicians’ trip to the bay amounts to much more than a social call. The quintet, which is rounded out by bass player Duylinh N'Guyen, drummer Stéphane Huchard and pianist Alain Jean-Marie, delivers an amazing show.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 54
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features Jermain 'Bad Intentions' Taylor (27-0, 17 KOs) making the 5th defense of his WBC and WBO Middleweight Titles, this time against upstart Kelly 'The Ghost' Pavlik (31-0, 28 KOs) on September 29, 2007 at Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA.

programme.title: American Ninja Warrior T7 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Top ANW athletes compete against each other to see who has the skills to go the furthest or fastest on various Ninja Warrior obstacles that have been made bigger and harder.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Lamont Peterson facing Amir Khan in a light welterweight title bout that ends in a controversial decision due to a point deduction. Also on the card, heavyweight kickboxing action.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T33 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 4 from Tokyo, Japan at the Ryogoku Kokugikan features Tamawashi, Daieisho, Chiyomaru and Yutakayama.

programme.title: Fight Quest T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Episode 11: Bangkok, Thailand - Hosts Jimmy Smith and Doug Anderson learn the Fight Discipline of Muay Thai and Martial Art of Punches, Kicks, Elbows and Knees with Masters Thakoon Pongsupha and Karim Pattana.

programme.desc: Sébastien passe un week-end avec des amis d’enfance. Ils se souviennent qu’à l’époque ils laissaient le sort décider pour eux et prenaient toutes leurs décisions en jouant au dé. programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.desc: Maggie, une ancienne journaliste, épouse du maire d'un village de Dordogne qui compte bon nombre d'expatriés britanniques parmi ses habitants, a été enlevée. Du sang a également été retrouvé dans sa voiture, ce qui suscite beaucoup d'inquiétude. Marleau mène l'enquête, avec l'aide d'un détective anglais à la retraite dont elle se serait bien passée.

programme.title: Survivre a l'hiver
programme.desc: Documentaire produit par BBC Studio. 2019. Réalisateur : Simon Baxter. Pour affronter les températures glaciales de l'hiver, les nuits sans fin et la pénurie de nourriture, les animaux adoptent différentes stratégies, comme l'écureuil qui stocke ses provisions dès l'automne ou encore les manchots qui se regroupent pour résister aux températures les plus froides du globe.

programme.title: Alentejo, le Portugal Authentique
programme.desc: Un film de Franck Decluzet Une production Ampersand. 2025 Entre ses plaines couvertes de chênes-lièges, ses villages médiévaux et son littoral encore sauvage, la région de l’Alentejo abrite une identité culturelle bien à elle. Ce voyage explore des traditions uniques comme la riziculture de Comporta, la vinification en jarres de terre cuite ou le chant polyphonique du Cante Alentejano.

programme.desc: Um bruxo famoso é obrigado a revelar os seus feitiços numa sala de audiências, em Las Vegas. Além disso, uma mãe descontrolada esmurra o ex-namorado e um procurador.

programme.title: Chaos In Court T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Duas famílias envolvem-se numa rixa após um réu ser condenado por homicídio involuntário. Além disso, um réu acusado de agressão sexual torna-se violento porque a fiança é negada.

programme.title: The Killer Beside Me T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quando Leesa Nascimento é morta com um tiro na cabeça, um ex colega que foi despedido é detectado com evidências que o ligam ao homicídio.

programme.title: The Killer Beside Me T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Uma pausa de almoço torna-se o pesadelo de duas secretárias que desaparecem à luz do dia. Uma mulher é encontrada morta, iniciando uma busca desesperada pela amiga desaparecida.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T3 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Em Sandusky, no Ohio, a polícia responde a uma denúncia de um tiroteio. Quando chegam, encontram um homem morto no camião e uma comunidade com medo de prestar declarações.

programme.title: A Killer Among Friends T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Investigadores acusam atores de um elenco de homicídio e os colegas dos atores revivem cenas do passado e percebem que estão na presença do mal.

programme.title: Mother, May I Murder? T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma brutal execução com nove tiros tem apenas dois suspeitos: a ex-mulher da vítima e o filho. A polícia descobre uma história familiar tóxica e a fúria assassina de uma mãe.

programme.title: Game Day Murders T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Mike Danton, jogador dos St. Louis Blues, é detido por estar envolvido num plano para contratar um assassino e a notícia choca a NHL.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quando duas adolescentes descobrem que namoram com o mesmo rapaz, digladiam-se nas redes sociais e na vida real, com consequências trágicas.

programme.title: A Killer Among Friends T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Investigadores acusam atores de um elenco de homicídio e os colegas dos atores revivem cenas do passado e percebem que estão na presença do mal.

programme.title: Obsession: Dark Desires T4 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: A vida de Christine com o marido violento, Shane, é um ciclo de medo, humilhação e violência. Quando foge com os filhos, ele persegue-a e o final é sangrento.

programme.title: Obsession: Dark Desires T4 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Michelle termina a sua relação com Richard, um alcoólico, que quer continuar a sua vida com ela. Porém, ele não aceita e a sua obsessão acaba por ter violentas repercussões.

programme.title: The Killer Beside Me T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quando Leesa Nascimento é morta com um tiro na cabeça, um ex colega que foi despedido é detectado com evidências que o ligam ao homicídio.

programme.title: American Monster T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O Dr John Hamilton e a sua esposa Susan têm tudo. São bem sucedidos, respeitados e estão apaixonados. Mas um tenebroso homicídio no dia dos namorados põe fim ao idílio.

programme.title: Dog Detectives T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os cães-polícias, Meg e Thor, juntam-se ao seu tratador, Martin, após ter partido uma perna. Seguem a pista de um BMW misterioso com ligações suspeitas a tráfico de droga.

programme.title: Dog Detectives T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Kane, lobo da Alsácia e PC Harris, tratador, têm um turno noturno ativo ao seguir um ladrão. Nikki, tratadora, investiga uma ameaça de bomba com Oscar, o cão que deteta explosivos.

programme.title: Dog Detectives T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Em Liverpool, o novato, Chico, encontra uma enorme quantidade de canábis num beco, ajudando o tratador, PC Bartley, a desmantelar uma grande operação de droga.

programme.title: Dog Detectives T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Em Yorkshire, Thor, um lobo da Alsácia, e uma unidade armada entram num prédio devoluto. A cadela pisteira, Meg, invade um apartamento com possíveis ligações a tráfico de droga.

programme.title: American Monster T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Quando Frank Hilley morre por causa de uma estranha doença, a cidade de Anniston fica de luto. Mas quando a filha de Frank adoece, começam a surgir suspeitas.

programme.title: American Monster T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Os Yates mudam-se para Spokane, que passa a ser assolada por um assassino que ataca jovens mulheres. Os vídeos da família expõem um dos mais infames assassinos dos EUA.

programme.title: American Monster T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Após gravarem o seu programa de TV na zona rural de Vermont, Chrissy e Charlie Billis têm um acidente de carro e apenas um deles sobrevive. Resta saber o que de facto se passou.

programme.title: American Monster T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Após mudarem para uma remota localidade do Colorado, a família de Ron e Cynthia Phillips tenta adaptar-se. Mas os seus vídeos escondem impulsos que podem levar ao assassínio.

programme.title: Terror Comes To Town T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Numa pitoresca e pequena cidade do Wyoming, uma rapariga desaparece ao amanhecer. Com a cidade em festa, os suspeitos aumentam e a polícia conduz a busca de um perigoso assassino.

programme.title: Terror Comes To Town T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Uma criança de nove anos desaparece de um parque de diversões em Long Island, em Nova Iorque e começa a corrida para travar um perigoso raptor de crianças.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A mãe adolescente, Cheyenne, encontra aceitação num grupo e vai viver com duas raparigas e os namorados destas, mas após encontrar o seu namorado, a desconfiança leva à morte.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Um grupo de raparigas começa a fazer uma grande amizade no acampamento da igreja. A vida leva-as por caminhos diferentes e os laços permanecem até que um deles desaparece.

programme.title: Swamp Murders T4 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Um bebé é encontrado abandonado nas margens do rio Scioto, no Ohio, e depois a polícia encontra o corpo assassinado da mãe da criança.

programme.title: Swamp Murders T4 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: O corpo de uma bela jovem é encontrado a flutuar num lago. As autoridades investigam os seus admiradores e descobrem que o amor do ódio são sentimentos próximos.

programme.title: The Dead Files T10 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Steve e Amy investiga atividade paranormal potencialmente violenta, que está a aterrorizar uma mãe vulnerável e o seu pequeno filho. Veja o que descobriram.

programme.title: Spooked Scotland T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: A equipa investiga um castelo amaldiçoado em Glencoe, onde o Clã Campbell assassinou mais de 30 MacDonalds a sangue-frio enquanto dormiam. Será que conseguem sobreviver de noite?.

programme.title: The Ghost Town Terror T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Depois de analisar os resultados da sessão da caixa-fantasma de Sapphire, a equipa encontra-se com Karen e revela tudo o que sabe sobre o mal que encontrou.

programme.title: La Chute De Londres
programme.desc: Les plus grands leaders du monde occidental sont attendus à Londres aux funérailles du Premier ministre britannique, mort dans des circonstances plus que douteuses. Mais ce qui avait commencé comme l'événement le plus sécurisé de la planète tourne rapidement au désastre. Cible d'un complot terroriste, la capitale anglaise est mise à feu et à sang et la plupart des chefs d'état sont faits prisonniers.

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: L’influvoleuse qui a arnaqué des dizaines de femmes Belle, charismatique, mère de famille et star des réseaux sociaux… Madame B se présentait comme une « mompreneuse » inspirante, promettant réussite et épanouissement grâce à ses formations miracles à près de 3 000 euros.

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: Les escrocs n'ont peur de rien. Leurs victimes ne sont plus seulement de parfaits inconnus, ils s’attaquent aussi à leurs proches : conjoints, amis, amoureux, membres de la famille... Et les conséquences sont souvent dévastatrices. Il aurait arnaqué une quarantaine de femmes Près de Chartres, un homme est soupçonné d'avoir manipulé et dépouillé des dizaines de femmes rencontrées sur des sites de rencontre.

programme.title: The Rookie - Le Flic De Los Angeles
programme.desc: L'équipe et la division du FBI de Los Angeles sont engagées dans une course contre la montre pour stopper des camions piégés dispersés dans toute la ville. Le groupe de travail conjoint se méfie de l'implication de la CIA dans l’affaire.

programme.title: The Rookie - Le Flic De Los Angeles
programme.desc: Deux adjoints du shérif se font tirer dessus par un indic, Arroyo, dans un entrepôt, mais les preuves balistiques ne corroborent pas cette version. John et Aaron rejoignent l’unité spéciale dirigée par Garza pour infiltrer un réseau téléphonique illégal. Wesley prépare sa candidature au poste de procureur de Los Angeles et Bailey pousse John à envisager un poste fédéral pour la suivre à Washington.

Roland Gumpert, o fundador, conta poder vender o maior número possível de unidades para manter a empresa estável.

programme.desc: Movido pela visão de um homem, Sigurd Aase parte para reconstruir o maior navio viking alguma vez concebido e atravessar o Atlântico recorrendo a métodos ancestrais. Lutando contra tempestades, a fadiga e mares implacáveis, a tripulação tem de provar que a embarcação consegue sobreviver às condições de mar aberto e chegar à América do Norte sem motores ou tecnologia moderna.

programme.title: Grandes Máquinas Do Mar T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Nos locais onde construir em terra é impossível, os engenheiros constroem sobre a água. À medida que o tráfego, a meteorologia e a oscilação da água levam estas pontes ao limite, as equipas têm de agir rapidamente para evitar que pequenos problemas se tornem em falhas graves.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central: Aberto 24 Horas T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Quando a cidade celebra o seu 750.º aniversário, a estação está no centro das festividades. As funcionárias da Bilheteira e Atendimento, Gusta e Alexandra, vivem o ambiente comemorativo, enquanto fortes chuvas de outono começam a perturbar os serviços. Com a chuva intensa a atingir Amesterdão, os trabalhadores ferroviários correm contra o tempo para substituir carris desgastados.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central: Aberto 24 Horas T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O Natal é tempo de alegria na estação central de Amesterdão. Enquanto a estação se enche de espírito natalício, as salas de controlo estão em alerta máximo. Um comboio imobilizado está a causar atrasos. A equipa de segurança e serviço lida com incidente atrás de incidente. Para piorar, uma tempestade de neve paralisa completamente a estação.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Com os dias a ficar mais curtos e as temperaturas a descer, os residentes de Port Protection têm de se preparar para o Inverno difícil do Alasca.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Viver em Port Protection é uma aprendizagem contínua a respeito da arte da sobrevivência e os residentes têm de usar a sua criatividade para se adaptarem e prosperarem.

programme.title: Ilha Sem Lei T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: À medida que o Inverno se instala, os cidadãos independentes de Port Protection recorrem uns aos outros para manter a sua comunidade em bom funcionamento.

programme.title: Autópsia De Desastres T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Três desastres do mundo real analisados de forma forense. Em Madrid, a Torre Windsor foi consumida por um incêndio. Um desastre numa fábrica têxtil do Bangladesh que matou mais de mil pessoas – o colapso acidental mais mortal da história. A explosão do reator nuclear de Chernobyl, que espalhou radioatividade por toda a Europa.

programme.title: Autópsia De Desastres T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Três desastres do mundo real analisados de forma forense. Um comboio desgovernado em Paris que choca contra um comboio superlotado, matando 56 pessoas. Dois passadiços suspensos num hotel em Kansas City que colapsam sobre uma pista de dança sobrelotada. Um apagão devastador que paralisa o aeroporto mais movimentado da Europa e afeta dezenas de milhares de pessoas.

programme.title: Autópsia De Desastres T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Três desastres do mundo real analisados de forma forense. A explosão a bordo do vaivém espacial Challenger, que matou todos os astronautas. A falha do teleférico de Stresa, que deixou apenas um sobrevivente – um menino de cinco anos. E, ainda, o colapso do teto de uma pista de gelo em Bad Reichenhall durante as férias de inverno, que caiu sobre famílias de patinadores.

programme.title: Autópsia De Desastres T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Três desastres do mundo real analisados de forma forense. O naufrágio de um ferry grego que matou 80 pessoas. Uma explosão colossal numa fábrica química que destruiu totalmente as instalações e devastou um subúrbio francês. O colapso súbito de uma grande ponte rodoviária nos EUA, que fez cair 17 veículos no rio Mississippi e causou 13 mortes.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No Mississippi, agentes aduaneiros mandam parar veículos suspeitos de transportar produtos ilícitos. Na Florida, revistam uma embarcação vinda da Jamaica. Em San Juan, passageiros tentam entrar ilegalmente no país com medicamentos.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Em Atlanta, a polícia detém um homem intercetado com 100 quilos de marijuana, enquanto agentes de San Diego enfrentam um grupo agressivo de possíveis traficantes.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Em Newark, agentes aduaneiros procuram um carro de luxo roubado prestes a ser enviado para o estrangeiro. Na Florida, intercetam três embarcações suspeitas de envolvimento no tráfico de mercadoria ilegal.

programme.title: Contrabando Sob Controlo T1 - Ep. 8

programme.title: Primal Survivor T5 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hazen viaja até à Papua Nova Guiné para conhecer a tribo Mirr, uma tribo de caçadores recoletores que protege a todo o custo a sua terra e o seu povo. Hazen está ansioso por assistir a um casamento tribal, mas primeiro tem de provar o seu valor ao oferecer três objetos ao noivo. Sozinho num território hostil, será levado ao limite.

programme.title: Primal Survivor T5 - Ep. 4

programme.title: Primal Survivor: China T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Hazen Audel junta-se aos homens da tribo local no vale Dulong, no sudoeste da China. Enfrentando águas tormentosas, cobras venenosas e ursos, dirigem-se para uma missão nas montanhas nevadas. .

programme.title: Primal Survivor: China T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Hazen junta-se aos Biasha, a última tribo autorizada a usar armas na China, na sua aldeia montanhosa em Guizhou. Na sua estadia com a tribo, Hazen tem de dominar enormes búfalos e enfrentar cobras.

programme.title: Primal Survivor: China T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Hazen Audel junta-se aos Evenki nas florestas da Mongólia Interior, onde aprende a montar renas, pelas quais a tribo nutre grande apreço, e protegê-las dos ursos e linces nas noites escuras.

Enquanto René monitoriza o fluxo de viajantes, Menno e Baran lidam com os inúmeros visitantes doentes e agressivos. Gusta visita uma locomotiva histórica a vapor na estação.
